name: ndr
description: Marketplace for the NDR plugin, co-located with the ndr CLI it depends on

plugins.name: ndr
plugins.description: Nested decision records — atomic markdown decision atoms with supersession-aware reading, routed through the ndr CLI. Initialize a repo with `ndr init`, capture engineering decisions from any chat (/capture-decision), query the corpus by topic with automatic supersession resolution (/decisions <topic>), ground a coding session in relevant prior decisions before edits (/ground), audit code against current decision heads with /drift-check, and optionally bootstrap Obsidian vault content (/ndr-bootstrap). Requires the ndr binary on PATH (bun run install:bin).
